note: READ-ONLY AUDIT — pricing unit normalization proposal only

frozen_unit_inventory.issue: No unit field populated in frozen registry — must be inferred from human-decision.v0.3.md

collision_issues.issue: FLAT_INTERVENTION vs par intervention vs PER_INTERVENTION vs UNIT_FLAT_INTERVENTION vs FORFAIT_MINIMUM
collision_issues.description: Five strings for 'one fixed price per visit/intervention'. Must normalize.

collision_issues.issue: par cylindre / par serrure — French strings
collision_issues.description: Serrurerie uses French-language unit strings instead of enum values.
collision_issues.resolution: Canonical: PER_ITEM (with item_label field for display)

collision_issues.description: PER_INSTALLATION and PER_AC_UNIT are semantically the same for split AC (1 unit = 1 installation). PER_INTERVENTION is appropriate for diagnostic. Normalize: diagnostic = FLAT_INTERVENTION; cleaning/install = PER_AC_UNIT.
collision_issues.resolution: Canonical: FLAT_INTERVENTION for diagnostic, PER_AC_UNIT for cleaning/install

collision_issues.description: Bricolage hourly is per-single-worker; nettoyage is per-cleaner×count. MUST NOT collapse.
collision_issues.resolution: Canonical: PER_HOUR (bricolage, 1 worker implicit) vs PER_CLEANER_HOUR (nettoyage, worker_count explicit input)

collision_issues.description: Half-day is a time-block. Proposed canonical: FLAT_INTERVENTION with scope metadata.
These are per-item specifics (sofa size tier, mattress side count). Canonical unit: PER_ITEM; item_spec carries the tier.

collision_issues.issue: PER_M2 (nettoyage après-chantier) vs PER_PAINTED_M2 (peinture) vs PER_CEILING_M2 (peinture plafond)
collision_issues.description: THREE DISTINCT m² semantics. PER_M2 = floor/surface area. PER_PAINTED_M2 = painted surface (converted from floor area via conversion model). PER_CEILING_M2 = actual ceiling area measured directly. These MUST NOT be collapsed.
collision_issues.resolution: Maintain all three as distinct enum values. Estimator must ask correct measurement question for each.

collision_issues.description: Menuiserie batch pricing. Not a standard unit but a formula modifier on FLAT_INTERVENTION. Unit = FLAT_INTERVENTION; batch_rule field carries the increment.
collision_issues.resolution: Canonical: FLAT_INTERVENTION + batch_rule metadata; unit field = FLAT_INTERVENTION

collision_issues.description: This is not a unit — it is a minimum-floor policy. The 'service' PEIN-001 is actually a policy anchor, not a separately bookable service.
collision_issues.resolution: In canonical registry: PEIN-001 becomes a policy_ref (min_project_floor) referenced by all peinture services. Not a service with its own unit.

proposed_canonical_unit_enum.description: One price for one visit/intervention. No quantity input beyond eligibility check.
Price per discrete item (furniture piece, hinge, cylinder, sofa, mattress). Item type disambiguated via item_spec.
Price per air conditioning unit. AC-specific; do not generalize.
Price per door. Door-specific (menuiserie, serrurerie door work).
Price per hour for single worker. Minimum billing period applies. Bricolage only.
Price per cleaner per hour. Worker count is explicit input: TOTAL = rate × workers × hours. Nettoyage only.
proposed_canonical_unit_enum.warning: MUST NOT be confused with PER_HOUR

proposed_canonical_unit_enum.description: Flat block pricing for up to 4h of multi-task work. Bricolage only. Could be modelled as FLAT_INTERVENTION with duration_scope metadata.
Price per m² of FLOOR/SURFACE AREA. Nettoyage après-chantier. NOT painted surface.
proposed_canonical_unit_enum.warning: MUST NOT be conflated with PER_PAINTED_M2

proposed_canonical_unit_enum.description: Price per m² of PAINTED SURFACE AREA. Peinture walls. Converted from floor area via conversion model (RESEARCH_ESTIMATION_ONLY). NOT equal to floor m².
proposed_canonical_unit_enum.warning: MUST NOT be conflated with PER_M2 or PER_CEILING_M2

proposed_canonical_unit_enum.description: Price per m² of CEILING AREA. Peinture plafond. Measured directly from ceiling dimensions. NOT floor area, NOT painted wall area.
proposed_canonical_unit_enum.warning: MUST NOT be conflated with PER_PAINTED_M2

proposed_canonical_unit_enum.description: No standardized unit. Custom quote required.
